task_instance: Given a sample 5-person engineering team's roster, current project allocations, and 3 upcoming Q4 initiatives (provided as CSVs I authored), produce the /capacity-plan deliverable: a full Capacity Plan markdown report with current utilization per person vs. role targets, capacity summary, upcoming demand vs. available resources, bottlenecks, recommendations, and scenario comparisons.
evidence: Created input/team_roster.csv, input/current_allocation.csv, input/upcoming_projects.csv in the work directory. Ran a Python script (via Bash) to compute per-person capacity/allocated/available hours and utilization %, compare against the skill's role-based target bands (IC 75-80%, Manager 60-70%, On-call 50-60%), and identify overallocation (Mei Lin at 105%, computed as 42/40 hrs). Used these real computed numbers to author capacity_plan.md following the skill's exact required output template (Current Utilization table, Capacity Summary, Upcoming Demand table, Bottlenecks, Recommendations, Scenarios table). Verified the deliverable by checking the numbers in the markdown match the script output (total capacity 200 hrs/wk, allocated 174 hrs/wk = 87%, 1 person over 100%) and that all required template sections are present and populated with concrete, internally-consistent figures. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__capacity-plan@developer-sandbox/input/*.csv and capacity_plan.md. The skill's optional 'If Connectors Available' project-tracker/calendar integrations were not needed and not invoked; no MCP/connector tools were used.
